_comment: LLM backend for the News Intelligence Agent runtime. Copy to llm_config.json and edit. The runtime is model-agnostic — switch 'provider' to point every agent at a different LLM without touching agent code. 'deterministic' needs no LLM and runs the full pipeline off the Core alone (offline, zero cost).

_provider_notes.deterministic: No LLM. Each agent runs its declared Core tools and returns their outputs. Always available; used as the automatic fallback when an LLM call fails.
_provider_notes.ollama: Local Ollama. Set model (e.g. 'llama3.2:3b'), base_url defaults to http://localhost:11434. No key. Keeps the no-external-cost / Mac-cooling constraint.
_provider_notes.anthropic: Claude via Anthropic API. Set model (e.g. 'claude-sonnet-5'), api_key_env to the env var holding your key.
_provider_notes.openai: OpenAI OR any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (vLLM, LM Studio, Together, Groq, OpenRouter...). Set model, base_url (e.g. 'https://api.openai.com/v1' or your endpoint), api_key_env.
